items.title: Mike Davis interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2024
items.q: they treated the band, we all flew on the same private plane with them... Keith and Mick and Charlie and Ron are more important... best job I’ve ever had

ctx.x: Here’s a quote, when I spoke to him about the Rolling Stones he said, “You get to know their kids and grandkids and wives, it’s like a big traveling family.”

Yeah they’re great people to work for. I loved how they treated the band — terrific. You know they could very easily have been off to themselves, the four Stones and just dealt with the upper level management, but they treated the band, we all flew on the same private plane with them. We always stayed at the same hotels with them and they treated you like you were a band you know. And obviously Keith and Mick and Charlie and Ron are more important than the saxophone player or the trombone player, but they viewed…
I assume that they gave you a lot of notice when they were going to do a tour so that you could free up your calendar?
